notes.title: Improvement of controller steering & Bug Fix
notes.content:
The steering angle of a car can be controlled by the amplitude of the joystick.

Vehicles in both drift modes can now generate exhaust flames.

AI cars turn on and off their headlights according to the scene.

Fixed a bug in the end screen of the custom exercise mode.

notes.title: Main menu remake, Drifting AI, Brake lights, Widescreen optimization, and more!
notes.content:
We have been persistently improving our products and are very excited to introduce this update!

[h1]1. Main menu remake: [/h1]
We have remade the main menu and added new background music!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/40c66de36fd1008876dd166d689acaefd6a86bde.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. Drift AI: [/h1]
We have modified the enemy's AI, and the enhanced AI has better drift performance. They will frequently drift in bends. Newly generated enemies in custom exercise mode also have better pathfinding performance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/1db2016650ab459748001b37d2cc5b353d728f4f.jpg[/img]

[h1]3. Brake light: [/h1]
Added Brake light. When drifting and reversing, the brake light with a halo will light up

[h1]4. Widescreen optimization: [/h1]
Optimization has been made to solve the issue of incomplete widescreen UI display, and now the game UI can be well scaled on a very wide screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/57baa08cc277ff1d230ba9887b9c446aecf7ae72.jpg[/img]

[h1]5. Replay System: [/h1]
The Replay system has been optimized to no longer record stationary cars when pausing the game.

[h1]6. Car selection: [/h1]
Fixed the issue of selecting a car, and now the car you used in the previous race will be retained when returning to the main menu, without the need to select it again.

notes.title: Inertial drift & Manual shifting
notes.content:
Recently, the game has received some negative comments, and we believe they are very constructive. It is our fault to provide players with an insufficient gaming experience, so we have updated them based on these comments.
[b]We have built a new driving system.
Using inertial drift (physical drift) instead of "gave it a fairly unreliable dedicated drift button".
Now supports manual shifting! AT限定? MTだ![/b]
The higher the gear, the lower the torque of the car and the faster the maximum speed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/e739c0c89d38a0326852840708b55bd147fa7698.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/65145fcf5104526338b330d302e117f0cbe81191.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/03dafaa585ed4e9d6d99959ca33e1d6930a80d8f.jpg[/img]

[b]If you are accustomed to the old operating mode, you can switch back to the legacy one in the settings.[/b]
The additional settings have been added to the local configuration library, which means you don't need to reset them every time you open the game.

Fixed some errors and optimized the program.

We hope you all have a complete gaming experience

We are currently developing a custom key binding system and PS controller support, and will add more new features in the future

Thank you for your company

notes.title: Push and Bump!
notes.content:
A switch to control the collision is added in the settings. After it is turned on, there will be collisions between vehicles.

AI vehicles will automatically reset after overturning or flying off the track, and you can push and bump them freely.

Removed grass in the middle of some roads.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43594627/778bf9276e7257c1d463325b43dd0fe02bfe0646.png[/img]

notes.title: UI improvements for gamepad
notes.content:
According to user feedback, we have improved the UI

When a UI is selected, there will be [b]a noticeable animation effect of size changes[/b], rather than just slight color changes.

The UI can be pressed and cancelled using the AB button of the gamepad, and the gamepad control of the car free-placement menu in free exercise mode will no longer conflict with car driving.

Fixed bugs about camera.

Thanks to nomorevideos's kind suggestion.

notes.title: Patch made based on comments
notes.content:
We have received valuable comments and made improvements.

The speed of all vehicles has been increased.

Added a switch for the manga graphic filter. If you don't like it, just turn it off directly.

Fixed some errors

Optimized the program

We have always valued player's feedback and will continue to improve player's experience.

notes.title: We are developing new content !
notes.content:
We still have about a month to go before our game is officially released, and rather than waiting, we are willing to continue developing new features and content to make this game more interesting.

Content already added is listed in the "About Games" section of the store page, and currently being developed includes:

1. An 8-shaped training track for practicing drift skills

2. Customized exercise function, you can compete with up to 5 AI opponents of different vehicles on any mountain road

3. Steam Achievements

4. Custom background music function. You can select your local music as BGM

5. Optimize and fix bugs

These features will all be added to the game before the official release

There may be more in the future

Please continue to follow
